english: on the tip of my tongue
also: it was on the tip of my tongue
at the tip of my tongue

terms.gloss: be on the tip of one’s tongue
terms.grammar: prīmōrēs, prīmōrum, the front part, with labrum, labrī n., lip
evidence: Plaut. Trin. 4.2.65: versābātur mihi in labrīs prīmōribus (Lewis & Short s.v. prīmōris)
terms.comment: Latin keeps the word on the front of the lips, not the tip of the tongue. Prīmōribus labrīs attingere is something else: to touch a subject lightly (Cic. de Or. 1.87).

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 109.

phrases.english: It was on the tip of my tongue.
